prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 9:16 high-fashion beauty editorial of an original adult woman floating calmly in a crystal-clear emerald natural pool surrounded by dense tropical ferns. She has wet dark wavy hair, fair rosy skin, deep red lipstick, and small rhinestones delicately placed around her eyes and across the nose bridge. Keep the dark wet long-sleeve swim top shown in the reference. Frame her face at eye level, with a small waterfall and gentle ripples behind her. Use warm 5200K sunlight filtering through foliage, soft facial illumination, and caustic reflections gently shaping her shoulders and chest area through the swim top, with sharp eye focus and cinematic shallow depth of field. Keep the mood serene, ethereal, and darkly romantic; avoid recognizable celebrity likenesses, explicit styling, text, logos, and watermarks.
